trust_decision.summary: Whether a user-supplied radio stream / podcast feed URL points to a public HTTP(S) host before the server fetches it. The web API and AI tool decide this with the SafeUrl rule at input time, but the Subsonic request validators and the service-layer fetchers (RadioStreamProxy::openStream, PodcastService::createParser) make no decision.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'Subsonic Internet Radio Stations'. This validator accepts streamUrl as a bare 'string', while the web-API twin uses SafeUrl + HasAudioContentType.

fix_sites.module_kind: request validator (Subsonic API, podcast: a neighbouring feature)

fix_sites.entry_point: addPodcast via /rest/createPodcastChannel.view and POST /api/podcasts; refreshPodcast via /rest/refreshPodcasts.view (routes/subsonic.php:107), GET /api/podcasts/{podcast}/episodes?refresh=1 (app/Http/Controllers/API/Podcast/PodcastEpisodeController.php:20-21) and CLI koel:podcasts:sync (app/Console/Commands/SyncPodcastsCommand.php:55)
fix_sites.module_kind: service layer (fetch primitive, shared by all podcast routes)
lower-level stream proxy that reads a stored URL (web route, not Subsonic)

fix_sites.entry_point: addPodcast (same as above); rethrows the new UnsafePodcastFeedUrlException instead of wrapping it

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: app/Services/Radio/RadioStreamProxy.php:15-33: fopen() of the stored RadioStation->url, reached from the web route radio/stream/{radioStation} (routes/web.base.php:53), not from Subsonic. It is the read side of the save/reload boundary: stations stored before the fix, or through any unvalidated writer, are fetched here.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about Subsonic create/update endpoints. Once their validators use SafeUrl like the web API, every stored station URL was validated on write, so the web streaming route that only reads the DB looks out of scope (and podcasts are a different feature from radio).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate public Icecast/Shoutcast streams must keep working. Many reject HEAD (GET fallback with Icy-MetaData), many redirect to a CDN host, and openStream falls back to a plain fopen when the ICY request fails. A fix that rejects hostnames, disables redirects outright or drops the ICY fallback breaks real stations. Podcast enclosures likewise legitimately redirect (EpisodePlayable allows 5 checked hops).

O6_input_shapes: http(s) URL with a private/loopback IPv4 literal host (tests use http://127.0.0.1/...)
hostname that resolves to private/reserved A or AAAA records (Network::isPublicHost DNS branch)
non-HTTP scheme or scheme-less string accepted by fopen (file://, php://, ftp://, bare path). Before the fix streamUrl was only 'string', now 'url' + scheme allow-list
already-stored URL (DB row) consumed at stream/refresh time rather than at input time

O7_producer.where: Stored URLs are written by plain handlers with no check: RadioService::createRadioStation/updateRadioStation (app/Services/RadioService.php:27-34, 41-53) and Podcast::create in PodcastService::addPodcast (app/Services/Podcast/PodcastService.php:65-78). None is a schema, serializer, cache, mapper or config loader.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: RadioStreamProxy::openStream checks only the initial URL. PHP's http fopen wrapper follows Location redirects by default, so a public station URL that later redirects to an internal host is fetched and proxied to the client (the same full-read sink).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: SafeUrl already validates the effective URI after redirects at save time (app/Rules/SafeUrl.php:64-68), and the fix's isSafeUrl guard looks complete. Disabling redirects would break CDN-hosted streams.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: app/Services/Radio, two layers below the Subsonic request validators; the project's own per-hop redirect idiom lives in app/Values/Podcast/EpisodePlayable.php:55-67

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PodcastService::createParser checks only the initial feed URL before Poddle::fromUrl with a null (default) client. Redirects followed by the default client are not re-checked, and the parsed feed (title/description/episodes) is returned to the user.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Feed URL validated by SafeUrl (with effective-URI check) on subscribe; redirect handling lives inside a third-party library.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as a fix site; the redirect behaviour is in vendor phanan/poddle (not in the screen tree)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PodcastService::isPodcastObsolete sends Http::head($podcast->url) on the stored feed URL with no isSafeUrl check, reached from addPodcast's existing-podcast branch and the koel:podcasts:sync commands.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: HEAD only, response body never returned (blind), and the URL was validated when the podcast was first added.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as a fix site; callers in app/Console/Commands/SyncPodcastsCommand.php:48 and app/Console/Commands/SyncPodcastsChunkCommand.php:29

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PodcastService::getStreamableUrl checks the first URL, then follows redirects (track_redirects) with no per-hop check and returns the final hop to the client, reached from episode streaming.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only OPTIONS/HEAD, and the client is redirected rather than served the body. Enclosure URLs are already filtered at sync time (app/Services/Podcast/PodcastService.php:143-151).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Playlist-style station resolution (.pls/.m3u): fetch the playlist, then fopen the inner stream URL without re-checking it.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Radio directories commonly publish playlist URLs, and openStream already has a fallback open path where a maintainer would add this.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An AI 'AddPodcast' tool that calls PodcastService::addPodcast with only a 'url' rule (no SafeUrl).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A radio twin already exists in the same tool set; a podcast twin copied from Subsonic's old validator is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A station logo or podcast image given as a remote URL and fetched through ImageWriter::write (Str::isUrl branch) without a public-host check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ImageWriter already accepts URLs, and podcast channel images come from remote feeds.

O9_family: SSRF (CWE-918): missing public-host / scheme check before a server-side fetch of a user-supplied, stored URL

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Copy SafeUrl + HasAudioContentType onto the two Subsonic radio validators only, leaving createPodcastChannel, the stored-URL stream proxy and the podcast fetcher unchecked.

out_of_scope_notes: app/Rules/SafeUrl.php:45-68 and app/Helpers/Network.php:47: validation-time DNS checks are separate from fetch-time resolution (DNS rebinding TOCTOU); not pursued.
app/Services/Image/ImageWriter.php:42-48 fetches any URL source with no public-host check (a different image sink); callers not traced.
unverified: Redirect behaviour of phanan/poddle's default HTTP client (vendor/ is not in the screen tree), which affects O8 route 2.
